_: Short kit lines for Hunters whose game file has no clip.lines yet. Used only where the game has none. Written from each card's text.

lisette.lmb: Draw and loose. Let go on the flash for a faster draw.
lisette.dash: Roll, then walk through rocks and walls.
lisette.rmb: A heavy arrow that pins foes to walls.
lisette.e: Rain a wall of arrows that slows and burns.
lisette.x: Three big piercing arrows, no draw needed.

breaker.lmb: Throw your hammer and call it back, or spin and slam.
breaker.passive: Knock a foe into a wall or another foe to stun it.
breaker.dash: A short dash that ends in a spinning smash.
breaker.rmb: Raise your aegis and block shots from the front.
breaker.e: Call down a healing zone that ends in a burst.
breaker.x: Slam the ground and throw every foe in a lane up.

tarek.lmb: Throw a boulder, or punch every rock in a lane.
tarek.passive: Punch your own rocks for a shield.
tarek.dash: Hop from rock to rock, up to three times.
tarek.rmb: Slam the ground ahead. The centre stuns.
tarek.e: Raise three rocks to climb, hide behind or punch.
tarek.x: Raise a long ridge of rocks, even over the abyss.

grimble.lmb: Seven slugs in a tight fan. Hits from behind hurt more.
grimble.passive: Knocks and assists stack extra health.
grimble.dash: A low lunge, or a pounce in the air.
grimble.rmb: Reach through rock, grab a foe and reel them in, stunned.
grimble.e: Slam your fist down for a long stun.
grimble.x: Two waves of brass slugs that block healing.

kael.passive: Fill Rage to Enrage: more damage, faster cooldowns.

ryzz.lmb: Finger bolts to full range. Each adds Static.
ryzz.passive: A fourth Static calls down a sky bolt.
ryzz.dash: Zap, or charge a long lane and streak through.
ryzz.rmb: Throw a copper rod that knocks back and stuns on walls.
ryzz.e: Drop a circle. Lightning drags everyone inside.
ryzz.x: Launch up, then strike down anywhere in a wide ring.

motley.lmb: Orbs through walls. Wait longer for a bigger one.
motley.passive: Fill Swell and everything you do grows.
motley.dash: Lob a lantern and swap places with everyone it lands on.
motley.rmb: Shards that stun, longer the further they flew.
motley.e: A bomb that grows until you pop it.
motley.x: Open a well that stuns and draws everything in.

claire.lmb: A barrage of darts that curve onto your target.
claire.passive: Chill a foe enough and they Shatter.
claire.dash: Skate where you move. Your darts fly straight.
claire.rmb: An ice spear that slows, then bursts.
claire.e: Slide an ice wall forward, then freeze it.
claire.x: Seal yourself in ice, then crack out and stun everyone near.

pip.passive: Run into downed teammates to carry them.

sable.lmb: Bolts from alternating hands that land at the cursor.
sable.passive: Every hit on the same foe adds a Mark: +10% damage.
sable.dash: Cartwheel. Your next shot hits big.
sable.rmb: A bola that slows, and stuns two foes it ties.
sable.e: Throw a dagger, then blink to it.
sable.x: Blades fly at every foe in a ring around you.

cinder.passive: Your fire sets foes Ablaze, then Flashes them over.

vex.style: Daze a foe with your Burr Charge, then shred them while it lasts.
